items.title: Lawmakers Slash IEC’s 2027 Budget by D61.9 Million Ahead of Crucial Elections
items.summary: By Fatou Sillah The National Assembly has approved a D61.9 million reduction in the Independent Electoral Commission’s (IEC) proposed D669.7 million budget for 2027, trimming funds earmarked for fuel, election materials, training, allowances and travel ahead of next year’s par...
